title: Fixture/Setup Parameter Catalog — Stock, WCS, Clearance, Workholding ~200 Schemas
description: Generate parameter schemas, skills, scripts, and hooks for the fixture and setup domain: fixture body import/creation (~4 params), soft jaw design (~4), vise setup (~4), chuck/collet selection (~4), tombstone/pallet layout (~3), vacuum/magnetic workholding (~3), stock model creation (~4), WCS/datum assignment (~4), clearance planes (~6), allowance settings (~4), and coordinate system configuration (~4). Includes critical safety hooks for clamp interference, grip force vs cutting force, and clearance plane validation.

reference: hyperMILL training manuals (setup, workholding, clearance sections)

forge_triple.hook: fixtureSetupSafetyValidator — BUILT — validates clearance, clamp force, WCS consistency
forge_triple.action: generate_fixture_catalog — BUILT — generates fixture domain artifacts from schemas
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-fixture-params — BUILT — fixture/setup parameter reference and recommendations

sessions.title: Workholding + Stock Model Parameter Schemas (~100 params)
knowledge: Fixture body, soft jaw, vise, chuck/collet, tombstone, vacuum/magnetic parameter lists
Stock model creation parameters (bounding box, offset solid, from body, cylinder)
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for all workholding device parameters and stock model creation parameters. Critical safety hooks for grip force vs cutting force, clamp zone interference with toolpath, and centrifugal jaw loss at high RPM.

units.title: Workholding Parameter Schemas — vise, chuck, tombstone, vacuum ~60 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for all workholding types: fixture body (import, create, position, clamp zone), soft jaw (design from part, bore profile, step jaw, dovetail), vise (jaw width, opening, stop position, parallels), chuck/collet (3-jaw, 4-jaw, collet selection, grip force), tombstone (pallet layout, indexing, multi-part), vacuum/magnetic (zone definition, hold force, seal check). Safety hooks for grip force validation against computed cutting forces.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Schemas generated for >= 55 workholding parameters across 6 device types
Grip force validation hook compares hold force to KienzleForceModel output
Chuck centrifugal loss hook warns when RPM × jaw mass exceeds grip margin
Unit tests for vise jaw width range and chuck grip force computation

units.title: Stock Model + WCS/Datum Parameter Schemas — ~40 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for stock model creation (from bounding box, offset solid, from body, cylinder — each with dimensions, material, allowance fields) and WCS/datum assignment (G54-G59 frame parameters, datum transfer rules, probe verification settings). Stock vs part interference hook ensures stock envelope fully contains the part.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Stock model schemas: >= 16 parameters with allowance validation
WCS/Datum schemas: >= 20 parameters with frame consistency hooks
Stock interference hook validates stock > part in all dimensions
Unit tests for stock offset validation and WCS frame naming conventions

sessions.exit_gate: ✓ >= 95 fixture/stock/WCS schemas | ✓ grip force + stock interference hooks | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Clearance/Heights + Setup + Artifact Generation (~100 params)
knowledge: Clearance plane, retract, feed height, link parameters from Metric.cfg
Job management and coordinate system setup parameters
Allowance parameters (radial, axial, XY, corner radius, negative)
sessions.intent: Generate schemas for clearance/heights parameters, CAM setup parameters (job management, tool assignment, rest machining, transformation), allowance parameters, and then batch-generate all fixture domain artifacts (skills, scripts, hooks).

units.title: Clearance + Setup + Allowance Schemas — ~60 parameters
units.description: Generate schemas for clearance/heights (clearance_plane, retract_height, feed_height, top_height, bottom_height, safety_offset per cycle), CAM setup (job create/modify/copy, coordinate system, tool assignment, rest machining source), and allowance (radial, axial, XY, corner radius, negative allowance). Critical clearance plane safety hook and negative allowance blocking hook.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Clearance/heights schemas: >= 24 parameters with clearance plane safety hook
CAM setup schemas: >= 20 parameters with sequence validation
Allowance schemas: >= 12 parameters with negative allowance BLOCKING hook
Unit tests for clearance plane range validation and negative allowance rejection
